featured_reviews.name: Pritam Kasle
featured_reviews.review_text:
Yesterday we were at this amazing outlet of Shahi durbar situated just near to McDonalds at mahakali and can be easily located.
The ambience is super coool with yellow sparkling lights all around and tables arranged in a very sorted way. A cycle hung on one of the walls adds up to ambience.
Well we ordered for -
1. The chocolate nutella bubble waffle- the milk chocolate bubble waffle served with chocolate icecream scoop and alot of whipped cream topping with a perfect finish of droolworthy nuttella on it and chocochips was just astonishing to see and tasted more better than it looked. Totally loved it.
2. Red Velvet freakshake- A milkshake of red velvet crumbs topped with whipped cream and milkchocolate. It was average in taste and did not stand out of the box. It tasted more of like bubblegum milkshake. Instead i would suggest one to go for nutella or brownie freakshake since I have tried them earlier, they are much yummier than red velvet freakshake.
3. Dragon Breathe Poppers- These are something people must try. These poppers are served with nitrogen liquid and as you try to have it , it realeases alot of smoke. Something amazing to try and innovative as well.

Overall it was an amazing experience. The service can be made more quicker. The staff was courteous and the icecreams was scrumptious!
Ofcourse a must place for icecream lovers!
Based on personal Experience.
Follow us on Instagram @pri.delicious for more.

Both the popsicles were really tasty, especially the Oreo one. The Falooda was by far the best one I've ever had in my life. It was just outstanding. Topped off with nuts and a great deal of Ice Cream, it tasted really really good. The Freakshake was no less, it was thick, creamy and very delicious. The red velvet and cream on top made it a hell of an item to try. I would definitely recommend everybody to try out this place, you will not be disappointed.

We, as a family, have been a fan of Naturals ever since they opened their outlet at Juhu - when we lived at Shree Swami Samarth Nagar in late 1980s. I still remember bringing Naturals on my Bajaj scooter for the whole family. Seetaphal and Tender Coconut were amongst our favourites.

featured_reviews.name: VlogWithFurkan
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Tender Fresh located in Kalina, and it was such a sweet experience! 🍦✨
They are currently running a Valentine’s special offer from 12th Feb to 18th Feb where you can buy 2 scoops and get 1 scoop absolutely FREE – which honestly makes it a perfect dessert date spot.
Talking about the taste, we tried their Mango Ice Cream which was super creamy and refreshing. The Chilli Guava Ice Cream was totally hatke – sweet with a spicy twist that actually works so well! Their Chocolate Ice Cream was rich and classic, perfect for chocolate lovers.
The Kala Jamun Shake was something unique and indulgent – proper desi flavour in shake form. And to end on a sweet note, we had their Baklava dessert which was perfectly sweet and satisfying.
They have a good variety of ice creams, shakes and special desserts, so there’s something for everyone. Overall, great taste, good quantity and value for money. Definitely recommended for couples, friends and even solo dessert dates!
Will surely visit again. 🍨❤️

Loved their presentations and serve size. Ended our cravings with a chikoo shake taste and quality guaranteed
